name: Sandbox Link
description: Live link per channel: runs a project's scripts/sandbox/link.mjs to start a Vercel Sandbox dev server for a branch, and pins the link above the composer.

args: source ~/.zshrc >/dev/null 2>&1; R="$1"; shift; [ -n "$R" ] || { printf '{"state":"error","error":"No project folder set"}\n'; exit 2; }; R="${R/#\~/$HOME}"; fail() { echo "$1" >&2; printf '{"state":"error","error":"%s"}\n' "$1"; exit $2; }; cd "$R" 2>/dev/null || fail "Folder not found: $R" 3; [ -f scripts/sandbox/link.mjs ] || fail "No scripts/sandbox/link.mjs in $R. This project has no live-link script yet." 4; command -v node >/dev/null || fail "node not found on PATH" 5; exec node scripts/sandbox/link.mjs "$@"
